name: Create a campaign for an organization
description: Create a campaign for an organization Create a campaign for an organization. POST /orgs/{org}/campaigns
context:
POST /orgs/{org}/campaigns
Create a campaign for an organization. The authenticated user must be an owner or security manager for the organization to use this endpoint. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `security_events` scope to use this endpoint. Fine-grained tokens must have the "Code scanning alerts" repository permissions (read) on all repositories included in the campaign.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; direction (query) — The direction to sort the results by.; state (query) — If specified, only campaigns with this state will be returned.; sort (query) — The property by which to sort the results.
